text: (GADS) [38] provides information on existing plants (e.g., Generating Analysis Reports, Generating Availability Reports, Generating Unit Statistical Brochure, Historical Availability Statistics). These data for coal plants (e.g., PC, CFB, and IGCC technology) include average availability and plant CF data, by fuel type and plant capacity. The GADS database provides data on many plant operating characteristics. Two metrics are used in this report to evaluate existing plant availability and CFs (availability factor [AF] and equivalent availability factor [EAF]). The metrics are defined by the following equations. The EAF accounts for planned and scheduled derated hours as well as seasonal derated hours.
